clue.text: Hit and run, lacking care

parts.note: to hit is to slap
to run is to dash

explanation.surface: A hit-and-run driver who simply did not care.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done carelessly and in a hurry is slapdash.

clue.text: Endure without doctors held up in strike

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so these letters go round the rest

parts.note: to endure is to last

indicators.note: in a down clue, held up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: the BMA, British Medical Association, is the doctors' professional body

explanation.surface: Putting up with life with no doctors, caught in a long strike.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'held up' means read upwards; 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, and 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To lambast is to beat or thrash, so a synonym of strike.

clue.text: Foresight shown in editing centre of newspaper first

indicators.note: first says the middle letter is placed at the front of the other piece
the centre of the word newspaper is its fifth, middle letter

parts.note: editing is revision

explanation.surface: Foresight is needed when editing the heart of a newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: The ninth-letter word newspaper has P at its centre; 'first' puts it before REVISION.
explanation.definitionFit: Prevision is seeing ahead, foreknowledge of what is to come.

clue.text: Primate's mounting reputation year by year.

indicators.note: in a down clue, mounting means the letters climb, read from bottom to top

parts.note: a reputation is a good name
PA, per annum, means yearly

explanation.surface: A primate whose reputation is rising every year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounting' turns NAME plus PA as a whole, giving AP then EMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: An apeman is a hominid, an early human ancestor, i.e. a primate between apes and humans.

clue.text: Revolutionary device made with Kremlin cash allocation

indicators.note: an allocation shares things out, so these letters are dealt out afresh

explanation.surface: A Soviet emblem paid for out of the Kremlin budget.
explanation.walkthrough: MADE plus KREMLIN CASH, 15 letters, are rearranged; 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The crossed tools are the emblem of Communism, the device on the Soviet flag after the revolution.

clue.text: Seal long displayed in court

indicators.note: displayed in says one piece is set inside the other

parts.note: to long for is to ache

explanation.surface: A seal shown off for a long time in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A cachet is a distinguishing stamp or seal, as on a letter.

clue.text: Young female bird —- or converse .

parts.note: a chit is a pert young girl
a chat is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A girl or a bird, or perhaps a conversation.
explanation.definitionFit: To chitchat is to talk idly, a light form of conversation.

clue.text: Might they cure the lady's intake of drink?

indicators.note: an intake means something is taken inside the other piece

parts.note: the lady's means belonging to her, so hers
ale is a drink

explanation.surface: Will the lady's drinking cure her?
explanation.definitionFit: Those who cure are healers, doctors or practitioners of remedies.

clue.text: Small Dickensian overcome by strain died and went under

indicators.note: overcome by says one piece is covered over, held inside the other

parts.note: a strain is a tune
Little Nell is the heroine of Dickens's The Old Curiosity Shop

explanation.surface: A small character from Dickens collapsed under strain and died.
explanation.definitionFit: To have tunnelled is to have dug a passage beneath, i.e. gone under the ground.

clue.text: Hold up in motorway turn before deep diversion

indicators.note: before places the reversed letters ahead of the next piece
turn means the letters are reversed

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main motorway, written MI in crosswords

indicators.note: a diversion sends things a different way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Traffic held up on the motorway by a turn and a long diversion.
explanation.walkthrough: MI turned gives IM; DEEP rearranged gives PEDE.
explanation.definitionFit: To impede is to obstruct or delay.

clue.text: Champion isn't commonly found in deep water

indicators.note: found in says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: the main is the open sea
ain't is the colloquial form of isn't

explanation.surface: A champion swimmer who is not usually seen in deep water.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain a cause is to uphold it, to champion it.

clue.text: Chaff ordered to keep, one horse

indicators.note: to keep means to hold inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: bade is the past tense of bid, to order
I is the Roman numeral one
a nag is a horse

explanation.surface: Chaff ordered as feed for a single horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaff in the sense of teasing banter is badinage.

clue.text: Stick with company at present

parts.note: at present means in attendance, here

explanation.surface: Stay with the firm for now.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to hold together, to stick.

clue.text: Reportedly remained sober

indicators.note: reportedly signals a word that sounds like another

parts.note: remained means stayed

explanation.surface: Someone is said to have stayed sober.
explanation.definitionFit: Staid means serious and sedate, i.e. sober in manner.

clue.text: Merriment following opening of show is killing!

indicators.note: following means this piece comes after the first letter
the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: merriment is laughter

explanation.surface: A show so funny the laughter is killing.
explanation.definitionFit: Slaughter is large-scale killing.

clue.text: Dissipation in Paris with a lady. all but heavenly!

indicators.note: dissipation scatters things, so these letters are rearranged
all but means the word lady loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Wild living in Paris with a lady is almost heavenly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all but' trims LADY to LAD; PARIS, A and LAD are then rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Paradisal means like paradise, i.e. blissful and heavenly.

clue.text: Disquieted with disordered military command

parts.note: disordered in the sense of unwell, ill
at ease is an order given to soldiers on parade

explanation.surface: Uneasy about a muddled order from the army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disordered' looks like an anagram signal but means ill.
explanation.definitionFit: To be uncomfortable or anxious is to be not at ease; disquieted is the same state.

clue.text: Reader of lines about son of David

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other

parts.note: a palmist reads the lines on a hand

explanation.surface: A reader of verse speaking about King David's son.
explanation.walkthrough: 'son of David' looks like Solomon, but 'of' is a link and David himself is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: King David is traditionally credited with writing many of the Psalms.

clue.text: Awful digs in solitary surroundings nearby

indicators.note: surroundings means the first piece encloses the other

parts.note: solitary means alone

indicators.note: awful signals the word digs is jumbled

explanation.surface: Terrible lodgings in a lonely spot nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awful' scrambles 'digs', which is British slang for rented lodgings; 'surroundings' puts the solitary word round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Alongside means beside, close at hand.

clue.text: A ransom extorted from one in eight, say

indicators.note: extorted means wrenched or twisted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A ransom forced out of a rower.
explanation.walkthrough: An eight is a rowing crew of eight; 'say' shows the definition is an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A rower in a racing eight is an oarsman.

clue.text: Pawn opening has appeal

parts.note: P is the chess abbreviation for pawn
an opening move, as in cards, is a lead

explanation.surface: A chess opening with a pawn is attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: To plead is to appeal earnestly.

clue.text: A damp environment for Royal lover

indicators.note: an environment surrounds something, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: damp means moist

explanation.surface: A damp setting for a royal romance.
explanation.definitionFit: An amorist is a devotee of love, a lover.

clue.text: Mare on racecourse may need it for luck

parts.note: m is the racecard abbreviation for mare
Ascot is a famous English racecourse

explanation.surface: A horse at the races might need a lucky charm.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a charm kept to bring good luck.

clue.text: Creature found in the larger billabongs

indicators.note: found in signals the letters sit within the words that follow

explanation.surface: An animal discovered in the biggest Australian waterholes.
explanation.walkthrough: A billabong is an Australian waterhole; 'the' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A gerbil is a small burrowing rodent, a creature.

clue.text: Fighting sloth

definitions.meaning: fighting means in combat, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means in combat; as one, idleness, so laziness or sloth.

clue.text: Shrub is to be planted in river bank finally

indicators.note: to be planted in means placed inside the other letters

parts.note: the Tamar is the river between Devon and Cornwall

indicators.note: finally means the last letter

explanation.surface: A shrub to be planted on a riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tamar divides Devon from Cornwall; 'bank finally' adds the last letter of bank to the river before 'is' is planted.
explanation.definitionFit: The tamarisk is a feathery shrub of salty coasts.

clue.text: Heads managed to fill American agency

indicators.note: to fill means to go inside the other piece

parts.note: the CIA is the US intelligence agency
managed means ran

explanation.surface: Bosses got jobs at an American agency.
explanation.definitionFit: Crania are skulls, i.e. heads.

clue.text: Small flower for function permitted

parts.note: to function is to run, as a machine does
permitted means let

explanation.surface: A tiny bloom allowed to do its job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is something that flows, a stream, not a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: A runlet is a small stream, a little thing that flows.

clue.text: In doorway, about to take in petition

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: a doorway is an entry
to take in food is to eat

explanation.surface: Standing in a doorway, about to take in a petition.
explanation.definitionFit: An entreaty is an earnest request, a petition.
